name: Capstone Extras
author: Arendeth
license: Free to use with credit (see Mods/LICENSE.md)
description: Finishes classes the game left unfinished. Where a tree ends in a "* NYI *" placeholder, this fills it and adds strong capstone skills after the normal ones, up to the skills screen's nine slots. Off by default: turn it on for the extra skills, off for the trees as the game shipped them (a character keeps its ranks either way). The Cybertechnician gets its jamming spine.
